description: Really pretty especially in the fall. Road is winding and very steep (26% grade in spots!). The road is unplowed and closes to vehicles when there's snow, usually from November to May.

name: Dunbarton Rail Bridge
description: An old abandoned rail bridge. Although it was closed in 1982, you can just crawl under the fence and walk out onto the bridge. It's very pretty there and really cool to explore. The bridge has definitely seen better days. The bridge caught fire in 1998 and again in 2019, so be careful of the wooden ties. The surrounding area is weird (Fremont). The marsh has a strange odor and attracts a lot of flies and birds. People fish near the trailhead parking lot but I wouldn't eat anything caught there.
